technology.nri_angle: Wipro's push to train 10,000 AI specialists signals continued demand for AI-skilled Indian engineers globally, reinforcing the Indian IT sector's role as a major employer of diaspora talent.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Critical SharePoint Exploit Chain Lets Attackers Seize Servers Without Credentials
technology.excerpt: Rapid7 disclosed two chained vulnerabilities in Microsoft SharePoint that allow unauthenticated remote code execution. CISA confirms the authentication bypass is already being exploited in the wild.
technology.nri_angle: Indian IT services firms like TCS, Infosys, and Wipro manage SharePoint deployments for thousands of enterprise clients, making this vulnerability a direct operational concern for the Indian tech services sector.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Samsung Smart Switch Now Transfers Passwords, eSIM Data From iPhone to Galaxy
technology.excerpt: One UI 9 update eliminates the need to install an app on iPhones, adding QR-code-based wireless transfer for passwords, passkeys, and eSIM profiles.
technology.nri_angle: The update is relevant for Indian-American users considering switching from iPhone to Samsung Galaxy devices, particularly with eSIM transfer simplifying carrier setup.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: WhatsApp Replaces Six-Digit PINs With Full Passwords, Adds Multiple Passkeys
technology.excerpt: Meta's messaging platform overhauls two-step verification, expands passkey support beyond one billion users, and gives Android callers new scam warnings.
technology.image_caption: WhatsApp is replacing six-digit PINs with alphanumeric passwords and expanding passkey support as part of a major security overhaul. The changes target account takeovers and scam calls affecting the platforms 2.7 billion users worldwide.
technology.nri_angle: WhatsApp is the primary communication lifeline for Indian diaspora families staying connected across continents, making these security upgrades directly relevant to millions of NRI users.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Apple's Foldable iPhone Will Run iPad-Like Layouts and Bring Back Touch ID
technology.excerpt: The device opens to iPad mini size with side-by-side apps, drops Face ID for a fingerprint sensor, and could cost up to $2,500 when it launches this September.
technology.image_caption: Apple's headquarters in Cupertino. The company's foldable iPhone is expected to feature iPad-like layouts and bring back Touch ID.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Bengaluru's Airbound Raises $37M to Build Autonomous Drones That Could Rival Trucking Costs
technology.excerpt: The Series A round, led by Greenoaks with backing from DoorDash and Lightspeed, will fund development of larger cargo drones and expansion of a three-city delivery network in Andhra Pradesh.
technology.image_caption: An Airbound drone in flight during testing in India. The Bengaluru-based startup has raised $37 million in Series A funding to scale its autonomous delivery drone operations.
technology.nri_angle: Indian-origin deeptech startup Airbound's $37M raise signals growing global investor confidence in India's autonomous drone ecosystem, relevant for diaspora investors and technologists tracking the country's hardware innovation surge.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: India's ₹37,500 Crore Coal Gasification Push Stalls as Industry Demands Guaranteed Buyers
technology.excerpt: Companies say the government's 20% capital subsidy is not enough — they want assured offtake agreements, freight support, and land near coal mines before committing billions to gasification plants.
technology.image_caption: An industrial facility in India. The government's coal gasification initiative has stalled as private sector firms demand guaranteed offtake agreements before committing investment.
technology.nri_angle: NRI investors eyeing India's energy transition should note the commercial viability concerns clouding the coal gasification scheme before considering related investments.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Rukmini Vasanth Faces Backlash Over Intimate Scene in Yash's Toxic, Sparking Cultural Debate
entertainment.excerpt: A viral scene from Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups has divided audiences, with fans criticizing the Kantara actress's bold portrayal while others defend the film's creative choices.
entertainment.image_caption: Rukmini Vasanth at the Toxic trailer launch event. The actress is facing online backlash over an intimate scene in the Yash-starrer released on August 26.
entertainment.nri_angle: The debate around Toxic highlights evolving attitudes toward intimacy in Indian cinema, a topic that resonates strongly with diaspora audiences navigating cultural expectations.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Dhamaal 4 Wraps Theatrical Run at ₹160 Crore in India, Declared a Clean Hit
entertainment.excerpt: Ajay Devgn's comedy franchise closer finishes as Bollywood's fourth hit of 2026, crossing ₹224 crore worldwide and cementing its place as the actor's sixth-highest-grossing film ever.
entertainment.image_caption: Ajay Devgn, lead star of Dhamaal 4, which closed its Indian theatrical run at approximately ₹160.50 crore nett with a Clean Hit verdict.
entertainment.nri_angle: Dhamaal 4's overseas collection of ₹29.61 crore reflects strong engagement from NRI audiences who have followed the comedy franchise across its nearly two-decade run.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Obsession Crosses $500 Million Worldwide, Enters All-Time Top 5 Horror Films
entertainment.excerpt: Curry Barker's micro-budget horror sensation surpasses The Conjuring: Last Rites to become the fifth-highest-grossing horror film in history, delivering a staggering 670x return on its $750,000 budget.
entertainment.image_caption: Obsession, directed by Curry Barker, has crossed $500 million worldwide, entering the all-time top five horror films at the global box office.
entertainment.nri_angle: Obsession's remarkable ₹99.25 crore run in India underscores the growing appetite among Indian audiences for original Hollywood horror content beyond franchise fare.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Hanuman Ansh Declared a Box Office Success After Miraculous Third-Week Surge
entertainment.excerpt: The devotional drama collected approximately 8 crore rupees in 19 days after a massive word-of-mouth turnaround, with third-week earnings exceeding its first two weeks combined.
entertainment.nri_angle: The film’s success mirrors the growing appetite for devotional and mythological content among Indian audiences worldwide, following the blockbuster HanuMan (2024).
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: First-Day Viewers Slam Yash's 'Toxic' for Messy Screenplay Despite Record Advance Sales
entertainment.excerpt: Yash's long-awaited return to theatres draws sharp criticism for writing and pacing, though his screen presence and the film's visuals earn scattered praise.
entertainment.image_caption: Kannada superstar Yash at a public event. His highly anticipated film Toxic opened to polarized reviews, with first-day viewers criticizing its screenplay despite record advance ticket sales.
entertainment.nri_angle: Yash's Toxic recorded strong overseas pre-sales, including more than 400 screens in the UK, reflecting the Kannada star's pan-India and NRI following.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Doctors Urge Early Action on Malaria and Dengue as India's Monsoon Season Peaks
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Health experts warn that dismissing early symptoms as routine viral fever is the most common and dangerous mistake during monsoon months, when all Indian states except Ladakh are endemic to mosquito-borne diseases.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: NRIs planning monsoon-season visits to India should be aware of malaria and dengue warning signs and consult travel health specialists before departure.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Woman Develops Severe Brain Disorder After 15-Day Water-Only Diet, May Never Walk Normally Again
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Doctors diagnose Wernicke's encephalopathy after a Chinese woman's extreme fast depleted her vitamin B1 reserves, leaving her with a 'penguin-like' gait that may be permanent.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Wernicke's encephalopathy, a severe brain disorder caused by vitamin B1 deficiency. A 31-year-old woman developed the condition after a 15-day water-only fast.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Extreme fasting trends, including practices rooted in traditional Eastern medicine, have gained popularity globally; the case serves as a health warning for communities where prolonged fasting is culturally practiced.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: PM2.5 Pollution Linked to Millions of Cancer Cases Beyond the Lungs, Nature Study Finds
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A sweeping analysis across 952 global locations ties long-term fine particle exposure to cancers of the breast, digestive tract, and liver — with South Asia bearing a disproportionate burden.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Airborne particulate pollution. A major study in Nature links PM2.5 exposure to millions of cancer cases beyond the lungs, affecting multiple organ systems.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Indian cities face some of the world’s worst PM2.5 levels, making this study directly relevant to families in India and diaspora members concerned about relatives’ health.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Australian Baby First in World to Receive Precision Treatment for Rare Epilepsy
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Eight-month-old Bodhi went from 50 seizures a day to virtually none within weeks, while Indian doctors advance VNS therapy for drug-resistant cases.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: An Australian infant has become the first in the world to receive a precision gene therapy treatment for a rare form of epilepsy.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Indian doctors at CARE Hospitals Hyderabad are advancing VNS therapy for drug-resistant epilepsy, highlighting India’s growing capacity in neurological care.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Twenty Minutes of Exercise Works as Well as a Nap to Rescue a Sleep-Deprived Brain
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A McGill University study finds both a short workout and a 90-minute nap boost memory by 22% after 30 hours without sleep — but through different brain pathways.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: New research finds that just 20 minutes of exercise can restore cognitive function as effectively as a nap for sleep-deprived individuals.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Sleep deprivation is a widespread concern for diaspora professionals and shift workers; the study offers a practical intervention accessible to anyone with 20 minutes.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: HPV Vaccine Cuts Risk of Head, Neck, and Other Cancers, Studies Show
lifestyle-health.excerpt: New research finds the vaccine protects against cancers well beyond the cervix, with vaccinated men and boys nearly 50% less likely to develop several HPV-related malignancies.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A vial of HPV vaccine. New studies show the vaccine significantly reduces the risk of head, neck, and other cancers beyond cervical cancer.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Old Blood Accelerated Alzheimer's in Mice, Reviving Debate Over Transfusion Risk
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Animal studies show Alzheimer's-linked proteins can travel through blood, but the largest human studies on whether transfusions raise dementia risk reach opposite conclusions.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A brain scan comparison showing Alzheimer's disease progression. A new study found that old blood accelerated Alzheimer's pathology in mice.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Six Free, Evidence-Backed Daily Habits That May Add Years to Your Life
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Forget expensive supplements and longevity hacks — decades of research point to simple, everyday practices as the most reliable path to a longer, healthier life.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A person cycling outdoors. Research identifies six daily habits, including regular exercise and quality sleep, that may add years to your life.

sources.label: Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health

lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Many longevity habits align with traditional South Asian practices — plant-based diets, multigenerational households, yoga, and community gatherings
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: How to Make Ghevar at Home: The Rajasthani Sweet Perfect for Raksha Bandhan
food.excerpt: With Raksha Bandhan a day away, here is a step-by-step guide to making this honeycomb-textured Rajasthani festive dessert in your own kitchen.
food.nri_angle: Making traditional Indian sweets at home connects NRIs to their heritage during festive occasions like Raksha Bandhan, when distance from family is felt most acutely.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Same Brand, Different Recipe: Why India's Maggi, Fanta, and KitKat Have More Sugar and Less Cocoa Than UK Versions
food.excerpt: A Reuters investigation reveals how global food giants resist front-of-pack warning labels in India while voluntarily adding them in Europe, and how industry lobbying derailed FSSAI's push for color-coded warnings.
food.nri_angle: NRIs who regularly buy Indian brands like Maggi in ethnic grocery stores abroad are often consuming different formulations than what the same brand sells in the UK or US, raising questions about what version they are actually getting.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: FSSAI Cracks Down on Misleading Food Claims, Forces Bournvita Maker to Withdraw Health Labels
food.excerpt: India's food regulator has issued over 150 notices to major brands including Nestlé, PepsiCo, and Coca-Cola, banning '100%' claims and unsubstantiated health promises from packaging.
food.nri_angle: NRIs who purchase Indian packaged foods from ethnic grocery stores abroad will be affected as brands reformulate claims on products exported to diaspora markets.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: How IAS Officer Tukaram Mundhe's 3,000 Food Raids Are Reshaping Mumbai's Restaurant Industry
food.excerpt: Maharashtra's FDA Commissioner has suspended licences of Domino's, Pizza Hut, and McDonald's outlets, inspected Bombay High Court canteens, and turned food safety into a viral public movement.
food.image_caption: IAS officer Tukaram Mundhe, who has led over 3,000 food safety raids across Mumbai, reshaping the city's restaurant industry with strict enforcement of hygiene standards.
food.nri_angle: The crackdown resonates with NRIs who frequently raise concerns about food hygiene standards in India, particularly at restaurants and street food stalls they visit during trips home.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: United Airlines Launches Largest International Expansion With New A321XLR Routes to Europe
travel.excerpt: The Chicago-based carrier will debut its Airbus A321XLR on transatlantic service from Washington Dulles to Amsterdam and Dublin in December, part of a 10-city international expansion that includes routes to Luxembourg, Ibiza, and Marseille.
travel.image_caption: A United Airlines aircraft. The carrier has launched its largest-ever international expansion with new long-range A321XLR routes to European destinations.
travel.nri_angle: The new transatlantic routes and premium-heavy A321XLR offer NRI travelers between the US and Europe more options with lie-flat business class seats on a narrowbody aircraft.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Dubai Passenger Caught Hiding Gold Capsules in Mouth at Bengaluru Airport
travel.excerpt: CISF personnel intercepted an Indian national at Kempegowda International Airport after discovering two yellow-metal capsules weighing 82 grams concealed in his oral cavity during a routine security screening.
travel.image_caption: Kempegowda International Airport in Bengaluru, where customs officials intercepted a passenger arriving from Dubai with gold capsules hidden in their mouth.
travel.nri_angle: The incident highlights the persistent gold smuggling challenge on India-Gulf air routes frequently used by NRI travelers.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Elan Group Partners With Marriott to Bring JW Marriott Hotel and Residences to Gurugram
travel.excerpt: The licensing and management deal will add a JW Marriott hotel and branded luxury residences to a 50-acre integrated township on Dwarka Expressway, as India's branded housing market surges.
travel.image_caption: An aerial view of a luxury real estate development in Gurugram. Elan Group has partnered with Marriott International to bring JW Marriott-branded hotel and residences to its 50-acre township on Dwarka Expressway.
travel.nri_angle: NRI investors gain access to a globally recognised JW Marriott-branded luxury residence in Gurugram with professional Marriott management, reducing the challenges of remote property ownership in India.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Over 400 Flights Delayed and 15 Diverted as Monsoon Downpour Paralyses Delhi Airport
travel.excerpt: Heavy rain, thunderstorms, and 30-40 kmph winds disrupt operations at India's busiest airport; airlines issue travel advisories as waterlogging chokes road access across Delhi-NCR
travel.image_caption: Indira Gandhi International Airport in New Delhi. Heavy monsoon rains on Monday caused over 400 flight delays and 15 diversions at the airport, disrupting travel across the country.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs travelling to or through Delhi during monsoon season face flight delays, diversions, and cascading connection disruptions.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: From Spain to Egypt: How Eclipse Chasing Became One of Travel's Most Devoted Subcultures
travel.excerpt: The August 12 total solar eclipse over northern Spain drew thousands of astro-tourists from around the world, and the community is already planning for a six-minute totality in Luxor next year.
travel.image_caption: A total solar eclipse showing the sun's corona. Eclipse chasing has grown into one of travel's most devoted subcultures, drawing thousands across continents.
travel.nri_angle: The 2027 Egypt eclipse, accessible via direct flights from India and the Gulf, offers the Indian diaspora a rare opportunity to witness the longest totality until 2114.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Karnataka Courts Western India's Travel Market at TTF Mumbai as Domestic Tourism Hits Record Stride
travel.excerpt: India's oldest travel trade fair drew over 10,000 professionals and 500 exhibitors to Mumbai, with Karnataka pitching heritage, wildlife and wellness tourism ahead of the festive season.
travel.image_caption: The Yana rock formations in Karnataka. The state showcased its heritage and nature destinations at the Travel and Tourism Fair in Mumbai.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs planning festive and winter trips to India will benefit from the tourism infrastructure and package improvements driven by states competing at events like TTF Mumbai.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: US Freezes Immigrant Visa Interviews Worldwide Days After Court Struck Down 75-Country Ban
carousel.excerpt: State Department cites global consular training on public charge screening as it pauses appointments with no timeline for resumption.
carousel.image_caption: The Harry S Truman Building, headquarters of the US State Department in Washington, DC. The department has frozen immigrant visa interviews at all embassies and consulates worldwide.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian nationals form one of the largest groups of immigrant visa applicants worldwide, and the open-ended pause adds fresh uncertainty for families awaiting green card interviews at US consulates in India.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Third Explosive Drone Found Near Leipzig Airport as Europe Confronts Russian Hybrid Warfare
carousel.excerpt: U.S. intelligence links the attack to Russian military intelligence after an armed drone was discovered near a Ukrainian cargo plane carrying ammunition at a key NATO logistics hub.
carousel.image_caption: Leipzig/Halle Airport in Germany, where a third explosive drone device was found amid escalating concerns over Russian hybrid warfare targeting European infrastructure.
carousel.nri_angle: The escalating pattern of hybrid attacks on European transportation infrastructure raises security concerns for Indian diaspora travelers and businesses operating across the continent.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.excerpt: Navneet Kaur's brace powered India to fifth place at the FIH World Cup in Amstelveen, their best showing since the inaugural 1974 edition.
carousel.image_caption: India celebrate after defeating Germany 3-1 in the 5th-6th classification match at the FIH Women's Hockey World Cup in Amstelveen. The victory secured India their best World Cup finish in 52 years.
carousel.nri_angle: A proud moment for Indian sports fans globally as the women's hockey team delivers India's best World Cup finish in 52 years.

carousel.title: HDFC Bank Faces US Class Action Over Alleged Deposit Scheme and Securities Fraud
carousel.excerpt: India's largest private lender has been sued in a New York federal court by investors alleging that the bank disguised payments as marketing expenses to induce deposits from a Maharashtra state agency.
carousel.image_caption: An HDFC Bank branch in India. The country's largest private lender faces a US class action lawsuit alleging deposit scheme fraud and securities violations.
carousel.nri_angle: HDFC Bank is one of the most widely held Indian stocks among NRI investors, and the class action directly affects those who purchased securities on the NYSE between July 2023 and May 2026.
